notes.title: Dev Log #01 - Why Astro Burn is created in the GDevelop Engine.
notes.content:
Dev log 01


Over the past few months, I’ve had countless friends and peers in the games industry ask me the same question — why did I choose to build Astro Burn in GDevelop instead of Unreal Engine, the tool I’ve used for most of my career?



In this video, I break it all down. I’ll share my reasons for switching engines, show new gameplay footage from Astro Burn, and give you a behind-the-scenes look at how I’m developing the game using GDevelop.
